prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Pasadena, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1430; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state whether you consent to this call being recorded.

A: Yes, I consent.

Q: Thank you. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Pasadena, Texas, during the afternoon. I was in the right lane and wanted to move over to the left lane because traffic was slowing ahead.

Q: What did you do before you changed lanes?

A: I checked my mirror and glanced over my shoulder. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I signaled and started to move over.

Q: Then what happened?

A: About halfway into the lane change, I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jolt. The other vehicle had come up on my left side and its side mirror clipped my door.

Q: Did your vehicle leave the lane or strike anything else?

A: No, I stayed in my lane. I pulled onto the shoulder and stopped as soon as I could.

Q: Did you notice any injuries when the collision happened?

A: My head hit the window pretty hard. Afterward I had a headache, I felt dizzy, and the light bothered my eyes. I also had some trouble concentrating on what people were saying.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They told me I had a concussion and asked me to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are your symptoms still present?

A: Some of them. The headaches come and go, and I get tired faster than usual. I'm following the doctor's instructions and taking time off work.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add before we end the call?

A: No, I think that covers it. Thank you for your time.
